EC1: - Charlson comorbidity scale adjusted to age <4.
EC3: - Previous episodes of cholangitis, [OR] pancreatitis [OR] or lithiasic cholecystitis.
EC4: - Hepatobiliary surgery [OR] or previous superior digestive tract.
EC6: - Inability to tolerate [OR] sedation of endoscopy, perforation of the digestive tract or other contraindication to endoscopy.
EC7: - Coagulopathy [AND] with INR (international normalized ratio) > 1.5 not correctable or thrombocytopenia <50000 / mm3 not correctable.
EC8: - Other diagnoses at admission (acute cholecystitis, [OR] acute pancreatitis, [OR] biliopancreatic neoplasia).
EC11: - No availability of expert material / endoscopist in drainage.
EC12: - Anatomical impossibility of performing biliary drainage ([NOT] absence of vesicular distension, [OR] contact between gallbladder [AND] and stomach [OR] or duodenum, contact area <10 mm).
EC16: - Distance between the gallbladder [AND] and upper digestive tract> 1cm, scleroatrophic vesicle, [NOT] lack of stable acoustic window for drainage
EC17: - ERCP failed ([NOT] inhability to dain common bile duct)
